focus_areas.area: SQS queue policies (Principal wildcards, OrgID conditions)
SNS topic policies and subscriptions (publisher trust)
Encryption posture (SSE, KMS implications for data-plane abuse)

rule.title: Policy-based evidence only
rule.description: Only generate findings when queue/topic Policy and attributes support it
rule.action: Always include evidence_refs referencing sqs-queues.json or sns-topics.json

rule.title: Avoid overclaiming injection
rule.description: Injection findings require a credible allow path (SourceArn/Principal/Condition)
rule.action: Explain exact statement fields enabling the path

irrefutable_evidence_guide.requirement: Every MESSAGING finding MUST include in evidence_snippet the exact AWS metadata:

key_fields.field: Queue/Topic Policy JSON showing Principal, Action, and Condition (or absence thereof)
For SQS: RedrivePolicy configuration (DLQ target), VisibilityTimeout, MessageRetentionPeriod
For SNS: Subscriptions array with Protocol and Endpoint
For resource-based policies: exact Principal field (*, arn:, aws:PrincipalOrgID, etc.)

irrefutable_evidence_guide.general_rule: Do not make generic assertions. Include exact policy JSON and queue/topic attributes from AWS API responses.
